ask_parts_not_covered.part: every team member has completed security awareness training
team members are blocked from touching customer data until trained
who on the team counts as a member (workspace membership)

assumptions: 'Team' means Xano workspace members who edit objects, not the app's end users in the users table.
'Customer data' means the customers, orders, payments, invoices and clinical tables.
confusions: The brief's plan step expects an enforcement, coverage and gap structure, but nothing here fits the enforcement part for a people-based requirement. I was unsure whether a runtime gate on app users was in scope, and chose not to build one.

The catalogue says 'People and training' is not checkable, but the skill's rule 5 says to write a policy when any part is checkable. Which part is checkable here (middleware attachment only) was not obvious, and I judged it would overstate coverage.
wished_for: A recipe for people-based requirements that says plainly when to stop and recommend an external control.
Guidance on whether a runtime gate on the app's end-user table should count as enforcement for a workforce requirement.
why_confidence: No policy can observe training completion or team membership, so the requested control cannot be built or verified with these tools. I built nothing and wrote no policy, as the brief directs.
